mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and risk appetite diminishes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP growth signals strengthening economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE spikes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of GDPC1 and HOUST increases on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investor sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in one month signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real returns are eroded.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in one month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS declines and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
